rationale: Adding depreciation (ebitda − oiadp) to a *liquidity* denominator is economically incoherent — a noncash charge is not a near-term claim — and because dp is small relative to lct the leg ranks nearly identically to act/lct, making this a cosmetic variant of the already-tested Liquidity-Backed Operating Yield / Liquid EBITDA Conversion signals.

It preserves the archive's strongest mechanism (industry-adjusted gross profitability × gross-to-operating conversion) while substituting a genuinely different conditioner — non-debt operating float versus funded debt share of total liabilities — rather than the generic current ratio, so the test is informative even though both legs are individually familiar.

This is a mechanical crossover of two existing archive legs (TS_MIN of after-interest profitability from Liquid Net Operating Floor and VOL of interest burden from Interest Burden Stable Profit), and the volatility leg degenerates toward a low/no-debt indicator (zero xint ⇒ zero volatility), so it largely re-tests the already-documented Debt-Light EBITDA / Trough EBITDA Debt Ceiling effect with redundant xint on both sides.

Conditioning gross-to-operating conversion on the recent *maximum* short-term-debt share of current liabilities is a defensible rollover-risk conditioner that is distinct from the previously tested volatility and float-stability versions, though the omission of the industry adjustment that helped related signals is a weakness given Stable Operating-Float Converter's sharply negative alpha.

Both legs are lifted verbatim from mediocre archive signals (Demand-Stable Net Operating Yield's VOL(sale/(at+lct)) and margin-floor variants), and it drops the IND_ADJ that was needed to make raw operating margin comparable across industries, so it reads as a downgraded recombination rather than a new mechanism.

Three-leg complexity built entirely from archive components, one of which (re/at − lct/at) already delivered ~zero/negative alpha in Retained Cushion Net Profit Floor, and the R&D treatment is internally inconsistent since xrd is added back in the numerator while xsga (which contains xrd) remains in the denominator.
